sources.evidence: Royal Greenland's official Ilulissat factory page identifies the prawn processing factory in Ilulissat, Greenland as a current Royal Greenland factory and states that it processes cooked and peeled prawns, Greenland halibut, cod, catfish and capelin.
The same official factory page describes the active production flow at Ilulissat as cooking, peeling, quick freezing, sorting and packing prawns, with year-round production when ice conditions allow.

Royal Greenland's official Greenland production-site directory lists Ilulissat as a production site with cold-water prawns and Greenland halibut as primary species, confirming the physical production location in Greenland.
